card.name: And/or after antiviral drug abbreviations
card.fires_on: The linking word 'and' or 'or' right after a drug name or abbreviation in a list of HIV/HBV drug components, such as FTC and tenofovir or lamivudine and zidovudine.

modes.label: Joiner after FTC
modes.description: 'and' or 'or' directly after the abbreviation FTC, before TDF or tenofovir.

modes.label: Joiner in drug combination lists
modes.description: 'and' after the second-to-last drug in a list of components of a combination tablet.

modes.label: Other stray spots
modes.description: Occasional numbers or 'the' in label text outside antiviral lists.
modes.example: At any time during<< the>> menstrual cycle.

card.plain: It fires on the 'and' or 'or' that links one antiviral drug to the next in combination-product wording.
